name: AI Audio & Music Generation
summary: Multi-provider AI audio generation supporting text-to-music, TTS, sound design, and voice synthesis workflows. Supports providers including WaveSpeed, fal.ai, and Replicate, generating high-fidelity audio clips with customizable voice, tempo, and style in 3-20 seconds.

inputs.description: Text input for audio generation. Can be a music description (e.g., 'upbeat electronic dance track'), speech/narration text for TTS, or sound design prompt (e.g., 'ambient rain with distant thunder').

outputs.description: Generated audio output as data URL (embedded) or streaming URL. Encoded in MP3, WAV, or OGG format depending on provider and configuration.
Audio metadata including duration (seconds), sample rate (Hz), format (MP3/WAV/OGG), bit rate, generation time, model, and voice/style parameters used for asset management and downstream processing.

executionNotes: This node abstracts multiple audio generation and TTS providers, with WaveSpeed as primary voice/music engine and fal.ai as fallback for specialized sound design. The selectedModel field routes to appropriate provider at runtime. Parameters are dynamically exposed via inputSchema and include: for TTS/voice (voice_id, speaking_rate, pitch, emotion), for music generation (genre, tempo, duration, instrumentation, energy_level), and for sound design (environmental_type, intensity, effect_chain). AudioHistory carousel maintains recent generations for quick reference and style matching. Duration range varies by model (TTS: 1-300 seconds, music: 10-120 seconds, sound design: 1-60 seconds). Output is stored as data URL for immediate playback or embedded in video workflows. Typical latency: 3-20 seconds depending on duration and provider.

exampleConnections.scenario: Direct TTS: Convert simple text prompts into narration or voice-over for video content, presentations, or accessibility.
LLM-generated narration: Generate story text with an LLM, then synthesize into professional voice-over or character dialogue with chosen voice personality.
Video soundtrack generation: After creating video, generate matched background music or ambient soundscape based on video description and mood.
Multi-modal assembly: Combine generated audio with video, images, and text into a complete media package for publication.
Iterative voice refinement: Use LLM to adjust narrative tone (e.g., 'make this more dramatic'), regenerate narration with different voice parameters for optimal performance.
